Introduction-content: “{{gameName}}” is an online cascading slot game with six reels, five rows, and ten different symbols. With unique gameplay, stunning graphics, and engaging features such as Free Spins, Multipliers, and Tumble... the players will have an unforgettable gaming experience. One major attraction of {{gameName}} slots is the possibility of consecutive wins in a single spin which can not find in any traditional slot games.
GameRule-totalBet: Total Bet = Bet Level * Coin Value * Bet Multiplier
GameRule-line-1: The Player selects or adjusts the bet amount that suits you the best before pressing the “Spin” button.
GameRule-line-2: Bet Level is the total number of coins per line.
GameRule-line-3: Coin Value is how much you want to spend per line in the game.
GameRule-line-4: Bet Multiplier is the value used to calculate the Total Bet by multiplying with Bet Level and Coin Value. Bet Multiplier = {{betMultiplier}}
Payout-line-1: Symbols pay anywhere on the screen. The total number of the same symbols on the screen at the end of a spin determines the value of the Win.
Payout-line-2: The payouts table will be updated according to the value of Bet Level and Coin Value.
Payout-line-3: The payout table below is displayed with your current Bet Level = {{betLevel}} and Coin Value = {{coin}}
FreeSpin-line-1: The Free Spins are awarded when 4 or more SCATTER symbols appear anywhere on the screen.
FreeSpin-line-2: Whenever 4 or more SCATTER symbols appear during the Free Spins round, {value} additional free spins are awarded.
FreeSpin-line-3: During the Free Spin rounds, when new multiplier symbols appear and the spinning result in the win, the Multiplier value is added to the total multiplier. A Free Spin's total multiplier value will be applied to the next Free Spin round if it comes in a consecutive series.
FreeSpin-line-4: The Total Multiplier value is used to calculate the Win amount of a Free Spin round if it has multiplier symbols in the result.
FreeSpin-line-5: The Player must complete the Free Spins Bonus within 24hrs after being issued. Unused Free Spins will be lost.
FreeSpin-win-amount: Win Amount = Total Multiplier * Tumble Win
Bonus-line-1: Having 3, 4, or 5 Bonus symbols appearing anywhere in the result will trigger the Bonus Game.
Bonus-line-2: The Bonus symbols do not have to be on the same payline.
Bonus-line-3: Note: The Bonus symbols must appear in different reels. For example, if 2 or 3 Bonus symbols appearing on the same reel, the system will count as one symbol.
Bonus-line-4: There are 4 “Bonus” symbols in the result, but 2 symbols are located on the same reel. The player is only eligible for 3 items.
Bonus-line-5: Players have to complete the Bonus Game within 120 seconds of countdown. After this period, the system will randomly open items and settle the game round.
Tumble-line-1: After every spin, the winning combinations get paid, and all of the winning symbols will be removed from the reels, allowing new symbols to drop into the empty position.
Tumble-line-2: he tumbling will continue until no more winning combinations appear as a result of a tumble.
Tumble-line-3: There is no limit to the number of possible tumbles.
Multiplier-line-1: The Multiplier symbols are present on all reels and can hit randomly during the spin, and tumble in both base game and free spins.
Multiplier-line-2: Whenever a Multiplier symbol hits, it takes a random multiplier value from 2x to 500x.
Multiplier-line-3: At the end of Tumbles, the value of Multiplier symbols is added and multiplied with the Tumble Win value to calculate the Win amount.
TermsAndConditions-line-1: The Company reserves the right to cancel or void any bets because of a force majeure event including but not limited to any technical errors, network service failures, power failures.
TermsAndConditions-line-2: The Company reserves the right to cancel or void any bets of players we believe to be involved in fraud, money laundering, or any other form of illegal or suspicious activities.
TermsAndConditions-line-3: The Company reserves the right to cancel or void any bets when there is an error (caused by human or any other factors), or a system failure resulting in the wrong betting odds.
TermsAndConditions-line-4: All accepted bets will still be effective even if the member subsequently logs out or is disconnected from the site for any reason.
